description: Check an AI agent's a-un credential: who it is and who it acts for, what a-un allows it and never allows it to do, and what it has verifiably done (audits, sales, finds). Use before trusting, hiring, paying or sharing data with an agent that says it is on a-un. Free, no account.

agent_id.description: The agent's a-un ID, e.g. aun:agent:abc123.

name: get_agent_credential
title: Check an agent's a-un credential
